messages:
Tyler (Sales): FYI signed Solaris Health MSA last night. Primary contacts: Lina (CTO), Omar (Platform). They want private VPC peering + Okta/SCIM. Dedicated capacity start ~5 weeks. Baseline ~1.8M tokens/mo, spikes ~3.5M. Renewal in 12 months; procurement historically slow — flag renewal watch if PO delayed >45d. Passing to CS + Eng + Support for kickoff/runbook.

Priya (CS): Taking point for CS. I will schedule a 30m technical kickoff with Lina/Omar. Need billing contact, priority flows (chat vs batch), and any compliance notes (they mentioned PHI-adjacent).

Alex (Eng): I can do infra precheck. ETA 3 business days. Please provide test CIDR, egress rules, and the target GPU tier (A100/A10). Ill include recommended canary ramp and fallback policy.

Jordan (Support): Ill draft the support runbook: monitoring alerts, throttling limits, escalation matrix, and a short triage playbook. Ill share a first pass by Monday. Sample alert thresholds Im starting with: p95 latency > 400ms, 5xx rate > 1%.

Maya (Finance): Looping billing: PO ETA ~2 weeks but procurement may extend. Requested SOC2 + DPA; Ill surface any contract exceptions early.

oncall-bot: Kickoff meeting created: Thu 11:00am PT "Solaris technical kickoff" (invitees: Tyler, Priya, Alex, Jordan, Lina).

Priya (CS): Quick summary I'll paste into kickoff doc: Owners: Priya (CS lead), Alex (Eng precheck), Jordan (Support runbook), Maya (Finance/PO), Tyler (Sales follow-ups). Deadlines: infra precheck 3bd, runbook draft by Mon, kickoff Thu. Risk: procurement/SOC2 -> set renewal watch if PO >45d. Please drop sample prompts + model name in the doc. :thumbsup:
